verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers self-hosting 'on your own infrastructure with full data ownership' (hoppscotch-docs-14), which lets an AI-native user control where data physically resides by choosing their own server location, but there is no explicit multi-region cloud hosting option or documented data-residency/region-selection feature for the hosted SaaS offering. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection in the hosted product, documentation naming specific data-center regions, and independent confirmation of residency controls beyond generic self-hosting.
